about: Minik Spud's one in-app purchase, filled in by Scripts/appstore-iap.py (workflow 'App Store in-app purchase'). The price is NOT here: the owner sets it in App Store Connect. The product ID must match SPUD_FULL_GAME_PRODUCT_IDENTIFIER in project.yml.
reviewNote: One-time, non-consumable unlock of the full game (Family Sharing on). Without it: up to 3 players, the Sunshine park arena, the Soft foam and Beach ball balls, the paint balloon for 3 welcome games and then one game a day, and the first 7 challenges. With it: up to 10 players, all three arenas, all five balls, paint balloons any time and every challenge. To reach it: Home > Play > Create game > tap any choice marked with a lock (e.g. Room capacity 4, Tropical beach or Neon party) > "Unlock the full game · <price>" > answer the grown-up multiplication question. Restore purchases is on the same screen.
